title: Protocol crates remain orthogonal to orchestrator-specific logic
context: kaava-rpc and kaava-tool-manifest are published and consumed by every tool repository, not just orchestrator.
decision: Protocol crates (kaava-rpc, kaava-tool-manifest) depend on nothing above them. Changes specific to the orchestrator go to src-tauri/, not protocol crates.
consequences: Enables extraction of apps to separate tool repos without breaking the protocol layer. Tool authors can adopt newer versions without orchestrator-specific coupling.
